# Chamuka Labs

> Chamuka Labs is an applied AI lab: we ship AI-native products, put research into practice, and build tools for AI agents.

Website: https://chamuka-labs.github.io/
Organization: https://github.com/chamuka-labs
Lab site: https://chamuka.ai
License: Apache-2.0
Work and general: dev@chamuka.ai
Security and conduct: security@chamuka.ai

DrawIt is an experiment under agent and human interaction. A canvas you and the model both edit. From thoughts to form. Coming soon as open source. That line is DrawIt's only, never the lab's. There is no public repository yet.

Brand system: Daybreak, at https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-design

Hire us: we build AI-native products and agent tooling for teams. Email dev@chamuka.ai.

## What we do

- Products: AI-native products. The model is in the artefact, not a chat panel on the side.
- Applied research: engineering that puts methods into running systems. No papers, benchmarks, or evaluation claims.
- Tools for agents: isolation, credentials, skills, and runtimes.

## Experiments

### Agent and human interaction

- DrawIt: A canvas you and the model both edit. From thoughts to form. Coming soon as open source.

### Other experiments

- [FormIt](https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-formit): Form builder for creating, managing, and collecting responses to surveys and forms. Demo: https://chamuka-formit.vercel.app
- [Waypoint](https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-waypoint): Desktop workspace for evidence-led career research. Site: https://chamuka-labs.github.io/chamuka-waypoint/

## Tools for agents

- [Vmette](https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-vmette): Hardware-isolated microVM sandbox for running local AI agents on macOS. Docs: https://chamuka-labs.github.io/chamuka-vmette/
- [Conduit](https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-conduit): Declarative action layer for AI agents over REST and MCP.
- [CredVault](https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-credvault): Multi-tenant credential vault for AI agent integrations.
- [Agent Run](https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-agent-run): Unattended runner for coding agents with rate-limit retry and verify-fix loops. Binary: `claude-run`.
- [Skills](https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-skills): Reusable skills and reference guides for coding agents.
- [Plane](https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-plane): Ephemeral compute platform built on Plane and OCI containers, with tiered isolation.

## Design system

- [Daybreak](https://github.com/chamuka-labs/chamuka-design): tokens, React components, and brand assets.
